# Skyline Valley Quests

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jun 13, 2024
- 6 min read

Updated: Jun 14, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_53db3a9092504148bd73518b9efacb89~mv2.png)

With thanks to Coffee888 and SugarBombsRADS

**SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS**

Out of respect for the Game Devs and their hard work in writing and creating the storyline, this guide will not go into detail on the questline, nor have many spoilers in it. It will cover a general walk-through, any tips or gear needed, as well as the quest rewards.

You will need:

- Food and Chem buffs for SPECIAL checks during conversations with NPCs.

Lists of buffs that boost each Special can be found __here__.

Turn off any Quests or Pip-Boy dailys that you do not need active. Some parts of the quest use map markers and it can be easy to get confused.

At some point, the quest splits in two different directions. Make a note of the name of one of the quests and turn it off in your Pip-Boy while you complete the other quest. You can go back into your Pip-Boy and make the other quest active again when you are ready.

__Quests__

**Quest Name**

An Unlikely Invitation

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_17566ad5fe68412ba2b64d7100ea774b~mv2.gif)

**Quest Type**

Part of the main quest.

**How to start the quest**

Open your Pip-Boy and scroll across to Radio and down to Vault-Tec Broadcast.

This broadcast will put a marker on your map, directing you to a location in The Forest, between Sutton and Slocum's Joe.

Speak to Alyssa and she will provide directions for the next part of the quest.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

You can skip this part of the quest and head directly to Vault 63. You will still receive all the rewards.

**Rewards**

XP

Caps

Stimpaks

Radaway

Purified Water

Grenades/Mines

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7fd7ed55b075464989c75009da56ddb8~mv2.jpg)

**Quest Name**

Gather Personal Effects from Craig's Friends guide.

**Quest Type**

MISC Quest

**How to start the quest**

Speak to Craig

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

Buff your Perception to 12 or higher, before starting this part of the quest.

**Personal Effect # 1**

Perception +4 SPECIAL Check

Interact with the corpse and then follow the blood trail over the edge of the cliff. The personal effect will be on one of the rock shelves, on the way down.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_92a03fbeb48245ca9be3fcd6caba81ab~mv2.jpg)

**Item: Miles' Hat**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a0fc18ce172148068bbbb31aec18a1f1~mv2.jpg)

**Personal Effect # 2**

Perception +8 SPECIAL Check

Enter the tunnel and interact with the corpse. Follow the blood trail deeper into the tunnel. The personal effect can be found on a plank of wood, next to a lantern, in front of the SOS sign.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_79ada744d8314ada9e4656d1d118fb65~mv2.jpg)

**Item: Rob's Journal**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5e752c74302c4ba68125d83697b482db~mv2.jpg)

**Personal Effect # 3**

Perception +12 SPECIAL Check

Interact with the blood pool in the middle of the road, just before the turn-off to the gate to Dark Hollow Manor.

At the gate to Dark Hollow Manor, the personal effect can be found on the ground, next to the Lost Ghoul, leaning against the wall, on the right.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a8ccaab984504114bab23a800ac8b962~mv2.jpg)

**Item: Rebecca's Holotags**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_396e6e39c0304fed9e54e101de783ab4~mv2.jpg)

Caps

**Quest Type**

Part of the main quest.

**How to start the quest**

Enter Dark Hollow Manor.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

Buff your Strength and Intelligence to 12 or higher, before starting this part of the quest.

The entrance to the basement can be found under the stairs, on the Western wall. Once you are in the basement, head toward the Southern wall, and a map marker will pop up for you to continue the quest.

The item Hilda requires to open the door can be found on any Lost that you kill inside the Manor.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

Read Alfie's Journal.

Investigate the noise in the generator room:

You will need Hazmat Gear

Jump onto the terminal and select Remote Door Control/Open Door.

**Quest Type**

**How to start the quest**

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

The disguise can be found in the small cabin, outside the mine.

Enter the mine and follow the crate tracks into the second room. Speak to Disciple Blair on the left and read the note on the box behind them.

Perception +4 SPECIAL Check

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c38f43b522c34de2853fe1565da98c76~mv2.jpg)

To explore the upper section of the mine, follow the cart tracks straight ahead until you reach a dead end, then take the stairs on your left to ascend.

To retrieve Pepper's password, first engage Elder Pepper in conversation. Afterward, follow the map marker to find and speak with Adept Scarlet. She will instruct you to search Alex's room. Proceed by following the area search marker on your HUD to locate Alex's room, where you will find the password on Alex's bed.

**Quest Type**

Part of the main quest.

**How to start the quest**

Speak to Oberlin.

**Notes and Tips for the Quest**

Pack for combat. You will need to clear a few areas to reach the end room.

You can choose to side with Hugo, Lock him up, or Kill him. The endings do not affect the rewards, it only affects the dialogue.

If you battle Hugo, he will regenerate his health three times in total, each time you defeat him.
